name: Ski ergometer
cue: Stand tall, hinge slightly and drive the handles down. Return smoothly; start with easy resistance.

name: Sled push
cue: Use a light sled, brace your trunk and take short steps. Keep your back neutral and stop if traction is unsafe.

name: Sled pull
cue: Use a clear rope lane and a manageable sled load. Brace, pull steadily and avoid wrapping the rope around your hands.

name: Wall ball squat throw
cue: Use a light ball and a suitable clear target. Squat comfortably, stand and toss; catch softly before the next repetition.

name: Barbell back squat
cue: Use rack safeties and a practiced light load. Brace, squat within control and stand without bouncing.

name: Barbell bench press
cue: Use safeties or a spotter. Keep feet planted, wrists stacked and lower the bar under control.

name: Barbell deadlift
cue: Set the bar close, brace and stand by extending hips and knees together. Lower under control; do not grind through lost position.

name: Rowing machine intervals
cue: Push with legs, lean slightly and pull. Recover arms, body, then legs; reduce the pace during easy intervals.

name: Brisk walk
cue: Walk at a comfortable, conversational pace. Use a stable surface and adjust speed to your balance.

name: Stationary cycling
cue: Adjust the seat for a slight knee bend at the bottom. Pedal smoothly, keeping the easy intervals genuinely easy.
